claim: Reviewed static fact, not a run of vLLM's code: vLLM's serving process (vllm/, csrc/, rust/) names HF_HUB_CACHE at two load-time sites (the second one is also named in a comment) and in test code, and nowhere else; the harness holds the list to the tree. (1) vllm/model_executor/model_loader/weight_utils.py _local_snapshot_dirs uses huggingface_hub.constants.HF_HUB_CACHE as the cache directory when none is passed, to find a cached checkpoint's snapshot directories; its only caller is drop_checkpoint_cache (in the same file), which evicts the checkpoint files from the page cache with posix_fadvise(POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED), and drop_checkpoint_cache is called only from DeepSeek-V4.1's load_weights and process_weights_after_loading when engram_config.use_thp is on (vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/model.py): the eviction runs once, while the model is loaded. (2) rust/src/text/src/backend/hf/model_files.rs SourceFiles::open reads the variable to find a cached snapshot of the model's tokenizer or config files before a Hub download, when the Rust front end (enabled by VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND) resolves the model's files at start-up. The three test sites follow the file's first #[cfg(test)] line. The variable chooses the directory those files are read from; it is not a size, a rate or a count, and neither site is on the path of a request. A load that finds the files elsewhere takes a different time, which is outside the window a run is scored over.
